content: Next 16.4 docs: nonce-based CSP requires dynamic rendering and is incompatible with PPR/static shell (cacheComponents); options are 'unsafe-inline' for script-src/style-src or experimental SRI hash-based CSP; Vercel Analytics loads /_vercel/insights/script.js same-origin in prod and va.vercel-scripts.com only in dev; start with Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only.
